Select exact IC50 activity rows for compounds tested against human Cytochrome P450 3A4. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records, then docs, then activities, then assays, then target_dictionary. Inner join compound_structures to require canonical SMILES. Filter by target name 'Cytochrome P450 3A4' and organism 'Homo sapiens', and by standard_type 'IC50' with standard_relation '='. Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi (prefer pubmed_id, fallback to doi), assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism. Do not deduplicate; keep all qualifying activity rows. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
